title: Timelike entanglement and emergent time in the critical TFIM ring: does an emergent geometry carry timelike correlations?
status: LEVEL-3 NEGATIVE (registered, SIM-2026-077): no lattice construction among the four registered gives Im S = pi c/6; awaiting Jon decision on the one C1 thread
origin: The project's origin video (Instagram reel DVe5jiJj1rv: a person as one 4D object, memory as touching another point on it). Scientific translation decided in the 2026-09-06 grilling: correlations between time-separated slices of one system = timelike entanglement entropy (Doi, Harper, Mollabashi, Takayanagi, Taki; PAPER-2026-139/140). The personal layer stays in the story.
claim: An emergent geometry built from the critical TFIM ground state reproduces the bulk-only piece of the timelike entanglement entropy (its imaginary part, i pi c/6) only if the construction carries a time direction; a plain scale-direction MERA cannot, and the glued transition-matrix network (GS MERA + Trotter brickwork evolution + conjugate) is the minimal object in which the question is open.

claim_levels.1: Reproduce Re S slope 1/6 in log((R/pi) sin(pi T/R)) and Im S = pi/12 on the lattice (both definitions).
claim_levels.2a: Agreement of the two lattice definitions (Gaussian Wick-rotated prescription vs exact transition-matrix pseudo-entropy) at finite n.
claim_levels.2b: Written negative: a plain MERA has no time direction and integer cuts, so no imaginary part (one possible outcome).
claim_levels.3: Glued transition-matrix network: does a minimal cut (log chi weighted; Synge cross-check) reproduce Re S; stretch: Im S.

killer_test: Level 1 passes, Trotter gate passes, and no chi produces the Re S slope from the network cut -> Level 3 negative. Level 1 failure is VOID, not a verdict.
budget: Level 1 plus one network attempt, ~2 weeks, RunPod < 20 USD; then a new decision from Jon.

prior_art_gate.open: a search for any published finite-n comparison of the two Doi et al. definitions is part of the gate and must be recorded before running

next_artifact: research/tools/timelike-ee/ROUTE-X-DERIVATION.md (transcription of PAPER-139 sections 2.2-2.4 into the exact lattice transition-matrix construction), then the Level-1 driver.
